_comment: CodeQL findings that are accepted rather than fixed, applied by scripts/codeql_gate.py.
Modelled on frontend/audit-allowlist.json, and the same rule applies: an entry is a
decision, not a snooze. It must say why the finding does not represent a real risk, and
it must expire so it is re-examined instead of quietly becoming permanent.
Anything not listed here fails CI at error severity.

allow.reason: With no SMTP host configured, send_email logs the message body, which holds a verification or password-reset link. This is the development mail transport: reading that link out of the console is the only way to complete either flow locally. The branch is gated on DEBUG, and with DEBUG off only the envelope is logged.
